Cookie notice

What cookies this site uses and how you can control them.

Last updated 5 October 2026

Who this notice is from

This notice is from Webco Services Ltd (company number 10607383), trading as Webco Cloud. For questions, email support@webcocloud.net. More on personal data is in our privacy policy.

What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored on your device when you visit a website. Similar technology (such as local storage in your browser) can also be used to remember choices during a visit.

Cookies we use

Essential

Needed for the site and order flow to work. For example, remembering progress through the start/checkout steps in your browser, and keeping a secure session when you use the client area or related tools. These are not used for advertising.

Payments

When you pay, you are taken to our payment provider (such as Stripe). That provider may set its own cookies on its checkout pages. Those cookies are controlled by the provider’s own policies.

Analytics and advertising

This marketing site does not currently set third-party analytics or advertising cookies. If that changes, we will update this notice.

How to control cookies

You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may stop parts of the order flow or logged-in tools from working properly.

Updates

We may update this notice when our use of cookies changes. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we do.

This notice is for information about this website. It is not legal advice.
